warnings: 'พื้นชั้น 1' here is the ground-level structural framing (this is an elevated/stilt house — see the cover render p.1 — so floor 1 is the open ground level, not an enclosed room); its members are marked with a 'GB' (ground beam) prefix, distinct from the 'B'-prefixed beams on the elevated floor-2 plan (S-05).
GB1/GB2 member sizes and rebar are not printed on this plan — spec confirmed on S-11 (บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_10_หน้า29_section_beam_slab.json): GB1 = 350x350mm, GB2 = 150x350mm.

BST2 (grid 1' , B to C) bears on the row-B GB2 beam at its start (a T-junction, not a grid/column intersection) and is not itself supported by a footing/column at its C end (no footing exists at grid intersection C1 on either foundation plan) — flagged bears_on_beam rather than split into the row-B GB2 run, per §5's beam-splitting rule (splitting is for a beam bearing ON this one being folded in, not for the beam that receives the bearing).

Row-C GB2 (from dummy grid 1' to grid 4) has no support at its own west end beyond BST2's foot — no footing exists at C1' or C1; recorded as printed (grid_ref_start '1'C' — i.e. C1') without inventing a support.

S0 tags (4 bays) are recorded as element_type 'slab' per §10; their spec (100mm slab-on-grade with Ø6mm@0.20m mesh over compacted sand, expansion joint at panel edges) is confirmed on S-11. SP tag (1 bay) is a precast-plank floor area (element_type 'precast_plank_detail'), see S-13 for the plank-joint spec.
'GS' or similar overhang markers were not observed on this particular sheet (unlike some other houses in this series) — none omitted.
